name: Anantavarman Chodaganga Unifies Kalinga
summary: Anantavarman Chodaganga (reigned 1078–1147) unified the Kalinga territories and established the great Jagannath temple at Puri around 1135 CE. The temple became one of the four sacred dhams of Hinduism and the Jagannath cult one of the most important pan-Indian religious movements.
